summary: Ghost is a headless Node.js CMS (TryGhost) for publishing and subscriptions: staff users (staff) author posts/pages with tags, authors and newsletters; site settings are key/value; public members sign up via magic links, comment, vote/report comments, subscribe to newsletters, and pay for tiers through Stripe (subscriptions, offers, gifts); publishing to a newsletter spawns email recipients delivered via Mailgun; integrations expose webhooks and API keys; automations run email sequences; webmentions/milestones/recommendations track the site's external footprint.
